title: Pod is not reached!
body:

comments.body: Ja, welches Protokoll soll ich Dir senden? Habe doch nur das aus der AAPS!

it must contain time 14:28 and before
I copied the log right after the error message. May I ask you how I get other log files?

Thank you for this information. So far I have not been able to connect my Android to my Mac. I've only ever sent the data via email. Will now check how I get to the data. Unfortunately I have to pass today. Sorry, I will report back the days when I have solved the problem of data transfer. Many greetings
Lothar

Unfortunately I cannot transfer the logs to the PC. The mobile phone (Pixel 4a) does not allow the transmission. Will clarify that next week. Possibly I'm going to get a new cell phone. Sorry for the inconvenience. Lothar
